```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "../scripts")
from theme import ESPRIT, base_layout, mpl_barh, mpl_donut

from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True, connected=True)

ai4u = pd.read_csv("../data/ai4u_projects.csv")
for c in ai4u.select_dtypes(include="object").columns:
    ai4u[c] = ai4u[c].astype(str).str.strip()
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Maître de stage · Product Owner · Stage d'été** — Direction d'équipes étudiantes
au sein de l'équipe de recherche AI4U (Artificial Intelligence 4 University) à Esprit Tech.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

n_total = len(ai4u)
n_po = (ai4u["role"].str.contains("Product Owner", na=False)).sum()
n_termines = (ai4u["statut"] == "Terminé").sum()
n_encours = (ai4u["statut"] == "En cours").sum()

print(f'''
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:0.8rem;margin:1rem 0;">
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_total}</span><span class="label">Projets AI4U</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_po}</span><span class="label">Product Owner</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_termines}</span><span class="label">Terminés</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_encours}</span><span class="label">En cours</span></div>
</div>
''')
```

## Évolution et répartitions

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

# Bar par annee
year_counts = ai4u.groupby("annee").size().reset_index(name="count").sort_values("annee")
fig = px.bar(year_counts, x="annee", y="count", text="count",
              title="Projets AI4U par année",
              color_discrete_sequence=[ESPRIT[0]])
fig.update_traces(textposition="outside")
fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=-45)
base_layout(fig)
fig.show()

mpl_donut(ai4u["role"].value_counts(), "Répartition par rôle")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

mpl_barh(ai4u["domaine"].value_counts(), "Projets par domaine")
mpl_donut(ai4u["statut"].value_counts(), "Statut des projets",
          colors=["#2E7D32", "#F57C00", "#9E9E9E"])
```

## Liste des projets AI4U

```{python}
#| echo: false
table = ai4u.sort_values("annee", ascending=False)[["annee", "nom", "prenom", "niveau", "formation", "role", "domaine", "statut"]]
table.columns = ["Année", "Nom", "Prénom", "Niveau", "Formation", "Rôle", "Domaine", "Statut"]
show(table, lengthMenu=[10, 25, 50], classes="display compact")
```
